title: Flow Analyzer Helm Chart Values
description: Configuration values for the Flow Analyzer Helm chart

cluster.title: Cluster Configuration
cluster.description: Global cluster configuration inherited from parent chart

storageClassName.description: Storage class for the ClickHouse volume (cluster default if unset)

ip.description: Static LAN address of the collector's localnet interface; empty for cluster-internal only

physicalNetworkName.description: OVN bridge mapping name (ovn-bridge-mappings '<name>:br-ex' on every node)

allowedExporters.description: Comma-separated addresses/CIDRs allowed to send flows; empty accepts any

targets.description: Comma-separated address[:port] list to poll; empty disables polling

bridgeTables.description: Also walk the bridge forwarding table (which switch port a MAC is on)

lldp.description: Also walk the LLDP neighbour table

devices.description: Comma-separated RouterOS 7 REST API URLs to poll (https://user@host, password from the Secret); empty disables polling

connections.description: Poll /ip/firewall/connection and store fasttracked connections' byte deltas as flow records

connectionsFasttrackOnly.description: Only connections flagged fasttrack (the ones Traffic Flow does not export)

connectionsMax.description: Most connection entries used per poll

healthIntervalSecs.description: Router health poll interval in seconds (0 = off)

wirelessIntervalSecs.description: Wireless registration poll interval in seconds (0 = off)

queuesIntervalSecs.description: Simple queue poll interval in seconds (0 = off)

netwatchIntervalSecs.description: Netwatch poll interval in seconds (0 = off)

firewallIntervalSecs.description: Firewall counter poll interval in seconds (0 = off)

url.description: Where web-api downloads the GeoIP database from (.mmdb, .mmdb.gz or .tar.gz; {license_key} is replaced with the MaxMind key); empty leaves GeoIP off

knownNetworks.description: Comma-separated network=kind:name entries (kind router, remote or local) naming parts of the network

dnsServer.description: Resolver for reverse DNS; empty uses the cluster resolver

url.description: AdGuard Home address whose query log feeds passive DNS; empty disables polling

targets.description: Active monitoring targets: icmp://host, http://... or https://..., comma-separated; empty disables probing

timeoutSecs.description: Seconds to wait for an answer

enabled.description: Listen for sFlow v5 on UDP 6343 of the collector's LAN address

forwardTo.description: Collectors every accepted NetFlow/IPFIX datagram is relayed to (host:port, comma-separated); empty = none

interfaceRoles.description: Interface roles, exporter/interface=role[:name] comma-separated (wan, lan, vpn, management, ignore); direction then follows the interfaces

threatFeeds.description: Threat feeds: default, off, or name=url entries comma-separated

header.description: Header a login proxy sets whose value marks an admin (e.g. X-Forwarded-Groups); empty = no header rule

values.description: Comma-separated values of that header that mean admin

token.description: Put ADMIN_TOKEN from the Secret on the web-api

enabled.description: Evaluate the alert checks and rules in the web-api

dnsServers.description: Resolvers the LAN should use (addresses or CIDRs); empty turns the unexpected-DNS-server check off

ntpServers.description: NTP servers the LAN should use; empty turns the unexpected-NTP-server check off

mailHosts.description: Hosts allowed to send SMTP to the outside; empty reports every one

firewallWatch.description: Firewall rule comments (substrings, comma-separated) whose hits raise an alert; empty = off

enabled.description: Send notifications to the webhook in the Secret (ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL)
Send notifications over the SMTP server in the Secret (ALERT_SMTP_URL)

schedule.description: Summary report schedule: 'daily HH:MM' or 'weekly dow HH:MM'; empty = none

to.description: Report recipients; empty = the alert recipients

dashboardUrl.description: Dashboard address for links in notifications; empty = the Route's address

enabled.description: Pull the secret from Infisical through the External Secrets Operator; false uses `secrets` instead

routerosPasswordKey.description: Remote key for ROUTEROS_PASSWORD, pulled only when flow-analyzer.routeros.devices is set

maxmindLicenseKey.description: Remote key for MAXMIND_LICENSE_KEY, pulled only when flow-analyzer.geoip.url contains {license_key}

adguardUserKey.description: Infisical key of the AdGuard user

adguardPasswordKey.description: Infisical key of the AdGuard password

alertWebhookUrlKey.description: Infisical key of the alert webhook URL

alertWebhookHeadersKey.description: Infisical key of the alert webhook headers

alertSmtpUrlKey.description: Infisical key of the SMTP URL

adminTokenKey.description: Infisical key of the admin token

secrets.title: Secrets without the External Secrets Operator
secrets.description: Only used when externalSecret.enabled is false

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret with CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD and, when SNMP polling is on, SNMP_COMMUNITY; empty renders one from the values below

clickhousePassword.description: ClickHouse password for the flow user; required when existingSecret is empty

routerosPassword.description: RouterOS REST API password for devices whose URL carries none

maxmindLicenseKey.description: MaxMind license key for a GeoLite2 geoip.url

alertWebhookHeaders.description: Extra webhook headers, Name: value pairs separated by ;
